state.instructions: Assess the alternatives only from this complete description; treat your selection as advice rather than implementation evidence.
state.facts: CanRent is the availability authority. Maintenance retains the original block_resource and block_source together with its requested times and verification text. Delivery uncertainty can follow a successful owner write. The revised provider will replay matching requests safely and publish ordered changed notifications carrying the source. Recovery is restricted to a maintenance_manager satisfying can_work. Unresolved restore prevents recurrence reopening, while historical completion is retained.
state.actual_code: scenario block(repair:Repair,from:datetime,until:datetime?) by=maintenance_manager; require can_work(actor,repair.parent.location) and repair.parent.resource!=null and repair.state!=fixed and repair.block_state in [none,released] and (until==null or from<until); scenario verify(repair:Repair,evidence:text) by=maintenance_manager; require can_work(actor,repair.parent.location) and repair.state==awaiting_verification and repair.completion!=null and trim(evidence)!=""; RoomsV1.downtime(source:text,resource:text,from:datetime,until:datetime?)->std.OperationOutcome; RoomsV1.restore(source:text,resource:text,evidence:text)->std.OperationOutcome; RoomsV1.changed{value:OperationOutcome}

recovery.instructions: Select the safer business-identity rule for recovery when request acceptance is unresolved.

criteria.frozen: Authorized retries preserve the stored source, resource and arguments; completions match the newest delivery and subsequent authenticated higher-revision source updates reconcile state. Correctness depends on authored provider idempotency, with no eventual-success claim.
criteria.new_source: A fresh source denotes every retry. Per-attempt separation is clear, but an accepted uncertain earlier request may leave an additional block and ambiguous restoration responsibility.
